title: ee.global_promotion.report.v1
description: Execution report for ee memory promote-global: the policy plan, durable source mutation, and derived-index reconciliation posture (dry-run plans set executed=false; an exact-content global twin reports alreadyPromoted=true and merges instead of inserting a sibling).

globalMemoryId.description: The global row this promotion created or matched; null when refused or dry-run.

alreadyPromoted.description: True when an exact-content global twin already existed (idempotent re-promotion).

indexJobId.description: Derived-index job queued for a newly inserted global row; null for refusal, dry-run, or idempotent merge.

indexStatus.description: Truthful derived-index posture after the durable promotion decision.

indexError.description: Derived-index reconciliation error when the source row committed but immediate recall did not converge.
